status.migration_ready: The modpack can move to client {gameVersion}
status.deferred: The update waits for the game to close
status.waiting: Waiting for a modpack update for {gameVersion}

hint.idle: The manager checks the client on start and on the schedule from the settings.
hint.no_client: Choose a client on this page or in the settings.
hint.not_installed: Install the modpack from the manager's Home screen.
hint.update_available: Install it while the game is closed.
hint.migrated: The client was updated from {from} — components and settings are in place.
hint.updated: Client {gameVersion}: the new version was downloaded, verified and installed.
hint.migration_ready: The client was updated from {from}. The installed version {version} works with it — move it while the game is closed.
hint.update_ready: The client was updated from {from}. Automatic moving is off in the settings — install the new version with the button below.
hint.deferred: The client was updated from {from}, but the game is running. The manager updates the modpack as soon as the game exits.
hint.unsupported: Client {gameVersion} is not supported: choose Lesta's Mir Tankov in the settings.
hint.waiting: The client was updated from {from}. The manager installs a compatible version as soon as it is out (when automatic moving is on).
hint.offline: We will try again on schedule. The components of client {gameVersion} are untouched.
hint.failed: {reason}. The details are in the log (About → Collect logs).
